title: Feature requests get a clearer path
summary:
A small community-facing cleanup made feature requests, OpenHands information, and contribution paths easier to find.

The homepage now points people to GitHub issues for feature requests, with the message moved into a more visible announcement.

The homepage announcement links to the OpenHands repository, and the README adds OpenHands to its feature and news sections.

The README now makes GitHub issues and Discord easier to find alongside other ways to contribute. Contact and link layouts were also adjusted for desktop and mobile.
